en.title: Minimum Cores to Run Closed-Interval Processes
en.description:
Each process runs during the closed interval [start,end], and a core can run at most one process at a time. Find the minimum number of cores.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of start end. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤start≤end≤10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 2, 2 and 1 respectively; intervals that only touch at an end point still overlap.
hints: Sort the start times and end times separately and scan with two pointers. When a start equals an end, process the start first, and update the maximum current concurrency.
